title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
@cursor Part 1 of 5 for issue #4: Incremental DOM mutations.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts and QA), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #4, then do ONLY Part 1.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): observe DOM mutations (#4)` with the tests and the smallest stubs so typecheck passes, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Create `packages/recorder/src/observers/mutation.ts`. Observe the document, batch one callback into one `mutation` event, handle simple add, remove, attribute and text changes. `stop()` disconnects.

Requirements:
- One event per observer callback
- Added subtrees serialized with the Day 03 serializer (`serializeNode`, the `Mirror` and the privacy options). Do not duplicate their logic.

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Tests for each simple change type and for stop()
- Tests are deterministic: happy-dom, no real timers. Flush MutationObserver callbacks explicitly, do not sleep.

Implementation commit message: `feat(recorder): observe DOM mutations (#4)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself:
`git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" -m "..."`

If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and list it in docs/decisions/README.md.

T
